threat_model.output_csv: machine-to-machine; not for direct spreadsheet consumption
threat_model.cryptographic_authenticity: tamper-evident by default; externally anchored when protected mode is invoked (OPT-IN)

deterministic_replay.method: two independent 1M-row runs of the same input
deterministic_replay.note: Deterministic invariant is the OUTPUT CSV (validated data). Evidence files (audit.json, lineage.json, manifest.json) include per-run timestamps; their roots are NOT expected to match across runs.

evidence_integrity.tamper_detection: VERIFIED — evidence_root.py computes SHA-256 root hash over 6 core artifacts; any modification invalidates the root.
evidence_integrity.default_mode: TAMPER-EVIDENT (recorded root stored inside the evidence directory)
evidence_integrity.protected_mode: EXTERNAL-ANCHOR (OPT-IN, not invoked by any production caller)
evidence_integrity.protected_mode_invoked_by: tests only (13 tests covering all 7 spec verification points)
evidence_integrity.protected_mode_status: F-003 is mitigated under protected external-anchor mode. Protected mode is OPT-IN and is not automatically invoked by the current CLI, Airflow, or release-gate execution paths.
evidence_integrity.external_anchor_trust_requirement: The expected_root MUST come from an independent/out-of-band trust channel. DQAEIP itself does not protect or generate the external anchor.

authorization.model: operator-asserted (SHA-256 scope comparison via hmac.compare_digest; NOT cryptographically independent)
authorization.direct_engine_path: internal — not a production execution path

concurrency.protection: os.makedirs(evidence_dir, exist_ok=False) at start of run_validation()
concurrency.behavior: first execution atomically claims the directory; second execution fails closed at stopped_at=evidence-dir-collision
concurrency.filesystem_assumption: local filesystem atomicity (mkdir atomicity). Distributed/network filesystems may require additional operational controls.

dependency_reproducibility.statement: Verified reproducible installation for explicitly pinned direct dependencies; transitive dependency resolution remains pip-controlled.

pii_protection.release_gate_scan: PASS — no prohibited content in release_gate evidence

scale.memory_profile: O(N) — engine materializes the full dataset in memory
scale.production_recommendation: Large-scale production ingestion should use bounded batches/partitions (e.g., from ClickHouse) rather than loading the complete dataset into memory.

F-003.title: Evidence forgery under attacker-controlled evidence directory
F-003.classification: F-003 is mitigated under protected external-anchor mode. Protected mode is OPT-IN and is not automatically invoked by the current CLI, Airflow, or release-gate execution paths.
F-003.description: Under the operator-controlled-evidence-directory threat model, an attacker with write access to the entire evidence directory can forge a self-consistent evidence set that passes the default TAMPER-EVIDENT verification. The EXTERNALLY ANCHORED verification (verify_evidence_root_with_external_anchor) closes this gap when the operator supplies a 64-char hex expected_root from an out-of-band trust source. Protected mode is OPT-IN and is not automatically invoked by the current CLI, Airflow, or release-gate execution paths. The external anchor's authenticity depends on the operator's out-of-band channel, not on DQAEIP.

F-004.title: CSV formula injection in output
F-004.description: Output CSV preserves source values verbatim per the frozen V1 contract. Formula-trigger characters (e.g., =, +, -, @) may survive. Output is machine-to-machine; do not open in spreadsheet software without sanitization.

F-005.title: Wall-time and RSS limits not enforced in-process
F-005.description: max_wall_seconds and max_peak_rss_bytes are declared in ResourceLimits but NOT enforced at the application level. The ExecutionMonitor class exists but is never instantiated by pipeline.run_validation or ValidationEngine.validate. Input-size, row-count, and output-size limits ARE enforced (pre/post-execution). OS/container-level resource controls (ulimit, cgroups, container limits) are required for wall-time and memory containment.

LIM-001.title: O(N) memory profile
LIM-001.description: Engine materializes the full dataset in memory (id_set, row_lineage_buffer). 1M verified; 2M/3.3M historically hit memory limits.

LIM-002.title: Airflow runtime not operationally validated
LIM-002.description: DAG parses and is structurally verified; calls run_validation; requires grant; no direct engine instantiation. Airflow is NOT installed in this environment. Runtime deployment is an operational prerequisite.

LIM-003.title: No customer data processed
LIM-003.description: Production readiness demonstrated on synthetic data only. First customer-data processing remains an operational acceptance milestone.

LIM-004.title: DL001-DL015 geography table unavailable
LIM-004.description: 7 SP1 successor golden tests skipped — external geography evidence not supplied. SP1 is out of V1 scope.

LIM-005.title: Transitive dependencies not fully pinned
LIM-005.description: Only direct dependencies (pyyaml, pytest, pytest-cov, setuptools) are pinned. Transitive resolution remains pip-controlled. A full pip-compile lockfile would be required for exact transitive reproducibility (out of V1 scope).

LIM-006.title: External anchor is OPT-IN
LIM-006.description: verify_evidence_root_with_external_anchor exists and is verified, but is NOT invoked by any production caller (CLI, Airflow, release gate). Operators wishing to authenticate evidence against an attacker-controlled evidence directory MUST invoke it manually with an out-of-band root.

deployment_conditions: Configure OS-level resource controls (ulimit/cgroups/container memory and CPU limits) for F-005 wall-time and RSS containment.
Use a unique --evidence-dir per run; concurrent-run collision prevention is now enforced in-process (first-writer-wins).
Do not open the output CSV in spreadsheet software if the input may contain attacker-controlled formula-like values (F-004).
Protect the authorization grant file via filesystem ACLs — anyone with read access can validate; anyone with write access can authorize any input.

If the threat model includes an attacker with write access to the evidence directory, invoke verify_evidence_root_with_external_anchor(evidence_dir, expected_root, output_csv=...) after each run, supplying expected_root from an out-of-band trust channel.
Assume local filesystem atomicity for concurrent collision prevention; network filesystems may require additional operational controls.
Deploy Airflow runtime and verify the DAG executes run_validation successfully (LIM-002).
Process the first real customer dataset as the operational acceptance milestone (LIM-003).

production_readiness.code_changes_recommended_for_v1: NONE — no further architectural changes are recommended for V1.
